title: What Our Students Say
subtitle: Here are some voices from our dancers – and our online ratings!

testimonials.name: Amanda W
testimonials.text: Fuego is a dance school where you feel welcome from the start. The teachers are knowledgeable and helpful. For me, dance has not always been a given; when I started at Fuego, I was very insecure in dance contexts, afraid of making mistakes, which made me tense and less motivated. Fuego has helped me grow as a dancer; you get feedback on a more personal level, both from the instructors and from the assistant instructors, which is invaluable.

testimonials.name: Elvir D
testimonials.text: Has given me a better understanding of several different technical aspects, more than just learning sequences.

testimonials.name: My R
testimonials.text: What I appreciate about Fuego is that you feel seen and receive specific feedback based on your dance level. With fantastic teachers and assistant teachers, there's always someone there with encouraging words and constructive feedback. Courses combine theory and practice, which also gives you a better understanding of the dance instead of just learning a choreography.

testimonials.name: Ricardo R
testimonials.text: I’ve improved so much since joining, especially compared to my experience at a previous school. The environment here is safe, welcoming, and free of pretension – everyone, from the main instructors Mikael and Irina to the assistant teachers, is genuinely committed to helping you grow as a dancer. You can feel the difference in how they teach: it’s not about showing off, it’s about real progress.
